title: [ingest] Auto-decision dedup threshold is 0.45, env-overridable
summary: extract-decisions.js DEDUP_THRESHOLD = Number(EXTRACT_DEDUP_THRESHOLD || 0.45): a proposed note whose top retrieval match scores >= 0.45 is treated as already-known and dropped. Note this differs from the 0.6/0.25 daemon thresholds — different subsystem, different tuned value.
